summary: Read terminal runtime authority without reducing unrelated subject history

replay.detail: Existing projections and claims are read unchanged; no replay is required.

schema.detail: No database schema or replicated claim change.

rules.detail: Single-origin runtime-only histories use canonical indexed field reads preserving omitted and explicitly null fields. Mixed-kind and multi-origin histories retain the existing actual fold and causal source-selection helpers. Eligibility, fields and unknown-authority guards share a read snapshot. Checkpoint rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Terminal authorization and refusal ordering remain unchanged. Owner-local reads retain desired-member terminal and driver precedence. Capability issue and consume behavior is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond the ordinary daemon restart; restart duration was not measured.

manual.detail: No migration or manual action is required.

recovery.detail: An older binary can read the unchanged store without recovery.
